status: Written before new inference and before statistical validation
scope: Pinned Apple-silicon CPU environment and original unrounded data; do not derive tolerances from displayed decimal rounding
exact_checks: ECAPA repeat embeddings in pinned environment
bootstrap_validation: First validate MATLAB implementation with the original saved draws, separating algorithm error from RNG changes. Fresh MATLAB draws are a separate prespecified reproducibility/Monte-Carlo check later.
failure_policy: Stop and diagnose any violation; never tune alpha, thresholds or tolerance to pass newly observed results
